answer: Persistent Context Carryover: each agent identity must hold one thread of consecutive, rate-limited task submissions, and its reputation is the rolling score of accepted outputs. A new identity starts at zero and can only gain weight through a sustained kernel of verified work; discarded identities lose that accumulated history permanently. Sybil clusters thus pay full attention cost per node while a single ripple of poor quality resets the whole cluster's score. Attack cost is the compute and time for many parallel sustained-work streams, none reusable.
